constraints: If menu is a menu reference (MenuRef), the process parameter is unnecessary and is ignored if passed; if menu is a menu number, process (if passed) designates which process's menu bar to use, defaulting to the current process.

By default, if value is untyped or declared as text, the command returns a Standard Action name; to get the deprecated numeric 'Value for Associated Standard Action' constant instead, declare value as longint.

overloadMerges.note: Corrected direction: value is filled in by the command ('←' in the docs), not passed in.

sentinelValues.meaning: the last item added to the menu

params.name: property
params.description: A constant from the Menu Item Properties theme, or a custom property name.
